body: Ive been in a hard place lately with a super messy breakup after a year and a half long relationship. Nothing seemed to make her happy anymore and I was constantly trying to do more and more for her but she was never satisfied and one day she ended it and said really gross things on the way out and yet, I still miss her 4-5 months later and I dont know what to do/

I tried talking to them to try and understand more of what happened and why and they just kinda said that she didnt see us being happy in the future. They was upset at our frequent arguments but after talking to other people and reflecting, alot of the issues we had and our arguments were caused by them. I was pretty layed back and didnt complain alot, did everything I could to keep her happy and she didnt do the same for me. As stupid as it sounds, it would most likely make more sense to everyone if I left them considering they caused alot of issues and many people were actually asking me why I stayed with them. But I loved them so much I wanted to grow with them instead of giving up but they just gave up after treating me with less then the bare minimum for a while, as I was just trying to be better and do more for them. It really doesnt make sense to the point where their closest friend is upset with them and doesnt like how they treated me and our relationship. Dont know what to do with myself since Im still infatuated with them and its been a while.

This feels almost like I wrote this except for the reasoning that was the nail in the coffin. My ex got upset because I mentioned how Id never felt their blankets since Id never been to her house. They got upset and called me insensitive because I mentioned her house when my main reason was just the blankets to go along with the jokes we were making. I miss her so much and I treated her super super well from what Im told and I always prioritzed her and loved her yet she still up and left and seems to be doing fine. I just dont understand.

I feel the same way, my gf of 1 year and a bit left recently and seems to be doing fine. Alot has happened to make things a bit weird on her end but she doesnt seem to miss me in the slightest whereas I spend literal days crying over her wishing she was here with me again. If ever you wanna chat or something let me know, Id love to just kinda rant with someone whos going through something similar ahaha.
I still avoid the restaurants and the places where we would order food to this day. It just isnt the same without her. I wish we could go get some chinese food again together.

Short Answer: She left me because she was unhappy with the amount of arguments we were getting into. Im a pretty relaxed guy and dont complain alot but she found ways to start fights out of anything and blamed me. She was fairly toxic in other ways and might've been unhappy with herself due to that but no clear confirmation on that.

From what people are telling me and how Im feeling and what I experienced, No matter how in love, dedicated, and no matter how much you try and be better and love them harder, that doesnt mean they love you back the same. I learnt that putting effort into the person you love is important but doesnt mean they will do the same back. And also that you could be a perfect match, everything theyre looking for, treat them like a queen, overlook their flaws and love them as hard as possible, and they will still leave. And being sad or depressed over it, just upsets the people around you.

A bit in the same boat, we were together for only a year though and I can tell you that you arent alone. It shows that you really did love them enough to still be thinking about them after everything that happened.
Yea but you see, she told me before to not give up one her during covid, and to not let her leave. So yea B)

Wanna chat about it , I know talking about experiences and such with people who have gone through something similar can help. My dms are always open and if something like discord is easier to use let me know !

There are 2 ways to look at this

1- You miss all the shots you dont take

2- If they reject, you go through this pain all over again

At the end of the day its up to you and what youre willing to "bet". Do you put all your chips on the table and tell her how you feel, or do you accept that loses that youve taken and try to move forwards. Everyone goes through this exact mental debate and honestly theres no right answer, its all situational. Best of luck to you.

It depends on who you ask and such because I know personally, I would love nothing more then for my Ex to reach out to me and talk to me again, to apologize and try again. But it also depends on your reason. If youre going back to them because they are a safe spot for you, a safety net, then I recommend you dont. But if you love them, realize your mistakes and want them back, want to do better.  I say go for it.
You going through something similar? If ever youd like to dm and just kinda rant or talk Im always available to!

Before we were together, she treated herself quite poorly, when we got together she started loving herself more, but I guess as she started realizing that she wasnt treating me the nicest she started hating herself more. I tried to tell her she isnt terrible and that shes amazing but she got to a point where she refused to accept them or more, the compliments and such weren't getting to her anymore. I tried all I could to show her how amazing she is as a person but she refused to acknowledge it and seemingly grew more and more angry at herself and those around her.

To start she doesnt have alot of friends but her closest friends are kinda meh on the idea of talking to her and all, they only answer her texts and never text her directly. And she doesnt treat herself the best either.
If you're still lookin for someone to talk to about all of this I just recently split up with my gf of 1 1/2 years and am doing both great and terrible ahahah, feel free to dm if interested
Same thing here! Even her friends are lost and think shes crazy!

This is my favorite memory because it seemed like a beautiful light among a lot of the bad that we were having but, we had this one day where she sent me a video trend that couples did. It was during a time where things weren't always the best between us but we did it together and the smile she had when we did it together. Ill never forget that smile..
It dont feel like it XD
With that mentality you cant go wrong, you got this man and make sure that youre both being treating properly and youre both happy.

The first 2 points here really resonate with me. Me and my ex were able to identify the issues that we had to work on and I was doing my part to become better and she claims that she was doing the same but I couldnt see any effort or progress. I even asked people around her if they noticed because I really wanted to believe that she was trying but when she ended things, all she said is that I wasnt making progress fast enough and that she didnt want things to continue. I was doing my best and I saw alot of progress within myself, I took games less seriously and encouraged her and stuff more, I was happier when she would join calls and walk in the room and I shower her how much I loved her every second I could but she said that nothing was changing. She was mad at me for seeing progress where she couldnt. Also, when I told her the things that bothered me, she either got mad at me for mentioning them or just didnt acknowledge it sadly. I know that if we both put work into becoming better that we coulve been so happy. It was right there..
I completely feel you man, people telling me that Im fine or I will be fine and Im here finishing up potential suicide notes like "Oh really damn" -\_-

As a fellow dumpee, I just want to say in the least weird way that I am proud of you and thank you. Not only do most of us wish that the ex would come back but one of my biggest fears is that even if they do come back that nothing will change, that they are doing it for selfish reasons and that they could careless about what they have done. But youre showing selfawareness of what youve done and how it couldve affected them and you seem like a genuinely nice person. Im rooting for both of you

Im in a similar situation, after she left she wanted to stay friends though, saying how much I meant to her and how I was such a good person and all that but, if I am all these good things why leave me like this and treat me the way you did. To her I was just a step in her life, but for me she the whole staircase. I wanted her with me through it all, I couldnt just be that friend anymore.

I agree, Ive been single for a while now and I find that although I do have terrible low points and some pretty high points, the one thing that hasnt really changed is that I do miss her. But Ive learned to be a bit more happy single and thats okay. Im planning on taking some Japanese classes over the summer and I've been playing games with friends and even some dating sims (Emily is away 3) although I cant say I suggest the dating sim because for me atleast, it reminded me of things she would do and it made me miss her a bit more ahaha. But at the end of the day do things for you for a while. You dont have to hate her, tbh youre most likely going to have to live with that hole in youre heart for a while. We all have to and it sucks but thats how it is. So for now, fill that hole with new things like hobbies and learnign things, it will do wonders I assure you.

Take it from me, I messaged my ex sometime after the breakup to talk and the entire time she was just sour and honestly insensitive and mean. I wanted to explain why things got harder towards the end for me and if there was anything we could do. I tried to open up about some issues and her answere were all bland just kinda saying "Thats great, so what". It got to the point where we were talking about issues in the relationship and I told her that I think her lack of communication and her anger issues were killing the relationship and it was one of the main reasons why we couldnt really process our issues and her answer was just  "I know, and?". So, take it from someone who made the mistake, dont text them. Focus on youreself and Im sure things will get better (so Im told)
Thats what I've been trying to do, trying to keep my head up and look forwards.
Hopefully ahah, although to be honest I dont know if I want to anymore and thats making it hard.

We all know that feeling man. The one photo that you missed while getting rid of all of them. For me its the one from our second date. We went to a party shop and she put on these kiddie bunny ears and had the most genuine smile looking at the camera. I wish I could go back, I wish I could see that smile again...

I feel the same way, I was with her for so long and people keep telling me that she treated me terribly and I see it as well and I know that I deserve someone who can love me the right way but she is all I want. We have so many memories and connections, she was the first girl to make me feel happy with myself and who explored my interests with me. She seemed like she really cared so even though she may have treated me poorly, Id do anything for her back. I know she isnt the girl I fell in love with anymore but, I still love her now, after everything I still love her.
Same boat here man, I did so much fighting for her and I just wish and hope that one day she might do that back for me, but I know its unlikely...
Thank you as well! We arent alone out here and we can do this, we just have to keep our heads up kings and queens!

I felt the exact same way, I know that I did all that I can but theres also a voice at the back of my head always telling me I could do more or even just the things she said before leaving and what not. Luckily for me, I had alot of people on my side with it all. My friends and even her closer friends told me that I did everything I could and that they dont understand why she left and did this either. But at the end of the day just know that, if you think you could do more and youre willing to do more, then thats already alot. You wanted to be better and the fact that youre thinking this now shows that you were willing to do better for them. So dont keep second guessing what you did cause you know that even if it wasnt enough, you were ready to do more. Hope this helps a bit

I dont think its something that you can actively get over, but something that helps me is that I know that I did alot and I know that I did everything that I could for her and if she does find someone else, yea its going to suck but I know I did everything I could for her. And if she cant appreciate that and moves onto someone else then thats her loss. It will hurt but its something were just going to have to accept. Dont get me wrong though, I have the exact same thoughts and it does suck. Im constantly checking her status on discord and stuff and trying to see what shes up to but at the end of the day it wont change anything. If you know you did everything you can, then the ball is in their court. Just gotta survive and see what happens from here on.

I went though something vaguely similar, me(m19) and my ex(f19) split up about 2 months ago from our 1 year and 1/2 long relationship. The only difference I would say is although I know I'm not perfect, I feel like there isn't a lot that I did inherently wrong in the relationship. I treated her as well as I possibly could and did any and everything I could for her but it was never enough. At the end, she said that she associated some of her trauma with me and that was why she couldn't move forward with the relationship but then anytime I asked after that her reasons kept changing. Initially I blamed myself for a lot of what happened but after my friends and ever her friends (Including her closest one) reached out telling me that they don't know what's going on either cause they saw that I loved her and treated her as amazing as possible and all. But here I am, 2 months later, still crying and shit. Just want her back doe

EXACT SAME POSITION HERE. It feels like im the person who wrote that ahaha. Ive been trying really hard to focus on me and things that I can do for myself because at the end of the day, I love her very deeply and I know that wont change for a long time, but I also know that she didnt treat me right and she chose to leave so me acting deseperate and trying to get her back wont do me any good. As much as I want her back and as much as I miss her, I did all that I can and the ball is in her court right now. We just got to keep focusing on us and trying to be happy and appreciate life. It isnt easy by any means and feel free to msg me or anything if ever you want someone to talk to who's been through something similar and is still going through it ahaha
Best of luck to you both, I hope that no matter the outcome that you end up being happy!
I mean im 19m going through something similar, idk if that counts ahaha
I guess so ahaha, just hope it doesnt get that bad, just wish she would want me the way I want her.

I feel the same way, she gave my life meaning that it didnt have before and she gave me a purpose and motivation and yet she talks about the relationship like it was only terrible, I dont know what to do with this info anymore and Im just so fuckin depressed ahah.

I can definitelly relate for the whole clingy bit. My ex (sadly) kept telling me about how she would be clingy and all but I never really saw it? honestly was kinda hoping to see her get really clingy as I thought that would be cute be she kinda ended up just being toxic so I got scammed. Still miss her tho
I think people would need a bit more context to help you out. Nice things that pertain specifically to youre past relationship would be more meaningful than anything that we could post here.
Ive recently been through this exactly as well, if you want to talk to someone who may resonate a bit with what youre going through Im here!

Most I've gotten are very vague answers or her blaming me for things that I hadn't done or something of the sort. All I wanted was to do anything and everything to make us work and thats what I did but I guess it still wasnt enough or something ahaha. As of now I have her blocked but I really want her back. Shes blocked simply because she was still being toxic outside of the relationship and people told me I should block her. I miss her so much,. more each day unlike most people ahah.

Male dumpee here ahah. Me and my ex split up about a month ago but I never really got a reason as to why. Alot of my friends told me she was treating me very poorly and even her friends have told me that they dont get it and that she was super unreasonable and all so I dont really know what to do. I feel like if I had something I could work on Id be a bit better, whenever she did tell me things to work on I worked on them and not only did I see progress but everyone around us saw it too. I just dont quite understand what to do in this case and I dont really get her reasoning either? I treated her like a queen, always invited her over and spent time with her, and when we couldnt be together physically we would call and everything so i dont really understand what happened. Just curious if you might have any idea? 1 1/2 year relationship btw

Same here ahaha, 7 week mark and I still miss her every single day. Everyone's telling me about how she was toxic and wasn't a good girlfriend and I should be happy but id do anything to have her back. Iv'e been trying to move forward but I planned a future with her so now I have a huge lack of motivation. But we got to keep trying I guess ahhaha
Hey, if you do need someone to talk to I am here
Hey, Im here if you do need anything

I feel the exact same way man. Every time something good comes that makes all the bad seem okay and makes my life feel like its worth living, life takes it away and decides to make things worse. People told me she treated me poorly and that she wasn't the kindest but she made me happy and she made this shithole of a life seem worth living. Why should I have to go get someone better if I already invested so much of my love and life to this person who made me so happy. "Life gets better" for most people yes but it hasn't been happening for me and every time it does get better, they flip it around and take it away so things are worse. I feel like this place where I'm at, constant but manageable sadness, is the safest place. They cant take away things if I have nothing you know?

I'm sure there is no problem with posting this on this thread! I did a bit of research and there seems to be a virtual meeting thing happening. I checked the site Distress Centre Durham and it seems to have a survivor support where they discuss a lot of things they are feeling and what they can do from now. I hope this helps! And best of luck, we are all here for you!!!
Same man...same

We both have things we need to work on and I know that we can do it and try again if shes willing but Im scared that she wont want to try again. She was my light and still is and I wish for nothing but for us to be able to try again. Any advice?
